about.title: About PalModManager
about.subtitle: Mod Manager & Developer Toolkit for Palworld
about.disclaimer_text_1: PalModManager is an independent open-source community project and is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with Pocketpair, Inc., Valve Corporation, or Nexus Mods.
about.disclaimer_text_2: Palworld is a registered trademark of Pocketpair, Inc. All associated game titles, trademarks, characters, artwork, and logos are property of their respective owners.
about.eula_text_1: Modifying Palworld is done at your own risk. While PalModManager includes automated safety backups and conflict prevention, the developers are not liable for save file corruption, game crashes, or server restrictions resulting from the use of third-party modifications.
about.eula_text_2: Always create regular backups of your save data before installing, updating, or removing large mod packages.
about.nexus_policy_text: This software interacts with the Nexus Mods API strictly adhering to the Nexus Mods API Terms of Service and Rate Limits. Mod downloads and metadata queries respect author rights and Nexus Mods Acceptable Use guidelines.
about.license_text: PalModManager is provided free of charge for personal, non-commercial use and community sharing. Monetization, paid distribution, or selling copies of this software is strictly prohibited. To guarantee safety and authentic updates, download exclusively from official releases.
about.credit_okaetsu: Creator of PalSchema and maintainer of the dedicated UE4SS Palworld fork.
about.credit_ue4ss: The original creators and developers of Unreal Engine 4/5 Scripting System.
about.credit_valve: Creators of Steam and the Steam Workshop platform.
about.credit_nexus: For providing the modding platform and public API for the community.
about.credit_community: All mod authors, creators, testers, and players supporting the ecosystem.

scanner.hero_initial_desc: Passive scanner that analyzes enabled mods to detect table collisions (PalSchema row edits) and hook collisions (multiple mods hooking the same engine function in Lua).
scanner.hero_hotkeys_initial_desc: Scans all enabled UE4SS mods to look for asynchronous key bindings (`Key.SOMETHING`) configured inside Lua scripts. You can bind new shortcut combinations dynamically.
scanner.hero_no_hotkeys_desc: No hotkeys were found in any of your enabled UE4SS mods.
scanner.hero_desc: Reading configurations and parsing files. This may take a few seconds.
scanner.no_conflicts_desc: All installed mods appear to have clean and independent hooks/data tables.
scanner.info_ue4ss_desc: Multiple mods can hook the exact same engine function simultaneously (callbacks will execute sequentially in order of mod loading). This is generally safe and compatible unless a mod explicitly blocks execution, alters return values incompatibly, or cancels event propagation.
scanner.info_palschema_desc: If mods modify different keys/fields within the same row, they can function together. However, if they modify the exact same field key, only the mod loaded last (lowest in the list/load order) will take effect, overwriting the earlier ones.
scanner.hook_conflicts_desc: Multiple mods hooking the same UFunction
scanner.internal_conflicts_desc: Duplicate files or repeated hooks within the same mod
